scope: Documentary PR metadata; no new execution or predecessor gate transfer

pr.body:
The unchanged QR entrypoint `https://github.com/Goldkelch/qik-vrt/blob/main/AI` returns 404. This change makes a task-bound Authority diagnosis executable through the existing Mesh authority-edge workflow, using a non-force REST branch update as the initial native trigger. The execution path has now been demonstrated; the original URL remains unavailable.

The new `authority_url_probe` operation reuses the existing R11 GET transport, fixes Goldkelch/qik-vrt and numeric repository/owner identities, binds native HEAD/TREE, verifies exact AI bytes when readable, and records credential delivery by name/presence only. It reuses the existing direct-token names and, when configured, the existing App route restricted to Goldkelch/qik-vrt contents:read. The admission job is excluded from probe execution. Credentialed redirects and automatic retries are rejected; artifacts contain metadata only.

The current native probe [37086743407](https://github.com/ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt/actions/runs/37086743407), attempt 1, executed code HEAD `7ed957669a8f6f0e03c62cff7787a45cfaceab12`, TREE `507870ae80f0a07906198c94aba0f06119f08f13`. Its 13 boundary tests passed, admission was skipped, and the diagnostic ended with `AUTHORITY_CREDENTIAL_DELIVERY_NOT_ESTABLISHED`: all three existing direct-token inputs and both App inputs were absent in that runner. The standard GITHUB_TOKEN read the Mirror with 200; Goldkelch reads by name and numeric ID returned 404. This establishes the current delivery gap, not the cause of Goldkelch's public 404 or global absence of credentials.

Artifact 11260896259 was downloaded through the native API and independently verified against native ZIP digest `ceca9dbe4aab5ca429f3d4a160911f9015c1780b1a6f9a4294da1f99c646cc53`. Executor HEAD/TREE and workflow bytes match. Fresh anonymous readback on 2026-10-03 shows HTTP 301 to the unchanged HTTPS URL, HTTPS 404 and raw 404. Hash-bound receipts and the exact next action are committed under `evidence/receipts/authority-url-execution-route-20261003/`; the first contract revision's evidence remains historical.

Final PR HEAD `3e8530f2beb158cdfebd3fa74d25498e7ac2aa4a`, TREE `3aeb41df3f9d9d47c6875ea5b09e0bec06e796c2`, adds receipts only over the executed code subject. Its own [native CI 37087173803](https://github.com/ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt/actions/runs/37087173803) succeeded with `MAKE_TEST_EXIT=0` and integrity verification of 3,932 entries / 3,923 immutable digests. The executed code subject also independently passed native CI 37086743364; 22 local probe/R11 contract tests passed. No successor gate is inferred from predecessor evidence.

The canonical integrity trio is regenerated on this isolated branch because current Main `6fb101b2815744b353f67e3fe88ba8458d3c36d5` omitted twelve newer receipts and retained stale existing digests. The protected ruleset writer and its historical structural test are unchanged.

The remaining external requirement is to bind an existing authorized credential with Authority contents read access into this runner through an existing direct-token name, or bind the existing App ID/private-key pair. Then perform a new initial probe invocation on an exact observed ref. Current callable tools provide neither the secret value nor a secret-binding operation. Protected repository writes, secret changes, permission expansion, reruns, Main promotion and deployment were not performed. Original URL restoration, Authority/Mirror equality and general EFFECT_ACK_DONE remain unclaimed.
